title: Analytic: circular metal pipe TE11 through a dielectric section, mode ports at m = 1 (body of revolution, FDFD)
description:
A hollow circular metal waveguide of radius a = 1 um along the rotation axis (em_fdfd_bor, azimuthal order m = 1: the fields of the fundamental TE11 mode, E_r, E_phi and H_phi non-zero on the axis), 25 nm cells (~3e4 unknowns, host SuperLU), pec r_hi wall on the grid edge (the pipe surface), cpml (20 cells) on both z faces, a dielectric section eps = 2.25 of length L = 1 um filling the whole cross-section. A mode_source (mode 1 = TE11, 1 W) at z = 0.41 um launches toward +z; mode_monitors at z = 0.81 um (incident: forward = the launched power, backward = reflection) and z = 2.41 um (transmitted); frequency_domain study, 25 wavelengths 1.8-3.0 um (single-mode at m = 1 in the empty pipe: TE11 cutoff 2 pi a / x'11 = 3.41 um, TM11 1.64 um).
Analytic (single-mode transmission line, TE wave impedance ~ 1 / beta; the section fills the cross-section, so TE11 couples to no other mode, also on the mesh: the discrete TE11 profile does not depend on eps): n1 = sqrt(1 - (lambda / lambda_c)^2) in the empty pipe, n2 = sqrt(eps - (lambda / lambda_c)^2) in the section, lambda_c = 2 pi a / x'11 (x'11 = 1.84118, the first zero of J1'); T = 1 / (1 + F sin^2(2 pi n2 L / lambda)), F = ((n1^2 - n2^2) / (2 n1 n2))^2, R = 1 - T. Peak T = 1 at 2.588 um (n2 L / lambda = 1/2), T(2.6 um) = 0.9998, T(1.9 um) = 0.776; n1(2.2 um) = 0.7645.
Spectra / Curves: em.transmitted fraction_positive vs the dashed T, em.incident fraction_negative vs R (the launch is exact: power_positive of em.incident = 1 W).
Derived values tab: T_2600, T_1900, R_1900, the launched power P_launch and n_eff_2200 (n_eff of the incident monitor) vs n1.
Field tab: |E|^2 of the last wavelength (3 um).
Expected agreement (first CPU run): the mesh error is ~1e-4 (n_eff 2e-4); T and R are set by the 20-cell z PML echo of the slow TE11 (amplitude ~4e-3: em.transmitted power_negative 0.7-1.4e-5 W), which ripples the launched forward power by +-0.35 % (P_launch 0.9964-1.0032) and T / R by a like cavity term with the section: up to 0.0065 in T (T_1900 0.0081 below), 0.003 in R; n_eff 2e-4.
